Honest identities welcome random checks; forgers fear them. A VRF beacon draws 5% each epoch, proof due in 2 epochs.

Honest side: one proof, 7 jurors verify, 3 passes enter a low-frequency pool. Forgery side: a miss freezes rewards 6 epochs, a second slashes 50%.

Honest cost: one proof, near zero. Forgery cost: 1,000 clones lock 120,000; a cedar of idle clones pays 6,000 per round, a mirror reflects every absence. Trellis passes are free.
